title: Norwegian Hash Browned Beet Patties
description: A hearty, flavorful dish featuring norwegian hash, beetroot, and kissed dry ingredients. Perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated beetroot, Norwegian hash, cubed bread, and hash browns.
Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape into patties.
Brush the tops with a small amount of oil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
